parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records — `ProcessInfo.ThermalState.description` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` — carries `is_sample_app: true`, which is a restraint marker that dominates action signals under the decision rules. Lifting the shared thermal-state description logic into the production `Wallpaper` package (or vice versa) would couple production code to sample-app semantics. The production counterpart `PerformanceControls.thermalStateLabel` in `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/DebugUI/ThemeDebugOverlay/PerformanceControls.swift` is a debug-UI helper that may legitimately diverge from the sample app's debug HUD over time, so the near-duplicate (Jaccard 0.75) is expected and intentional.
